text:
Nina C: Heads up  new hire Mateo starts Mon remote (OR). Checkr returned an "address discrepancy" and he asked whether he can use a notary for I-9 or if we need an in-person rep.
Paul G: Notary is fine for remote hires. Candidate signs Section 1, notary witnesses originals and signs Section 2 on their behalf using our Authorized Rep form. We reimburse up to $30 for local notary fees.
Rhea S: Quick checklist for Mateo: 1) Complete Section 1 before Monday. 2) Send notarized docs OR schedule rep inspection. 3) Upload Checkr docs (utility bill) if vendor asks. 4) Finish W-4 + direct deposit.
Tom W: I can be an authorized rep on Monday morning if Mateo prefers in-person at 9:30. Ill be in office then. If he wants mail/ship option, IT can hold laptop until ID scan is uploaded.
Nina C: Mateo prefers a notary at a UPS store. Hes worried about shipping passport. He sent a scanned receipt and said notary will sign the rep form.
Paul G: If notary signs the rep form, ensure the notary prints their commission number and date. Upload the signed form + Section 2 scan to /secure/hr/onboarding within 24h.
Rhea S: I'll DM Mateo the reimbursement form and the link to our onboarding checklist: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/onboarding-checklist. Also send W-4 + benefits enrollment links.
HR Bot: Reminder: Onboarding tasks pending for Mateo: I-9 (pending), Checkr (review), W-4 (pending), Direct deposit (pending), Benefits (pending). Auto-reminder scheduled 48h before start.
Tom W: Ops note: I'll add a "Hold for ID" tag to the laptop ticket IT-2209. If Mateo uses notary, ops to release after scan confirmed.
Nina C: Payroll flagged that W-4 + direct deposit need to be completed by Fri cutoff. Rhea, can you nudge him?
Rhea S: Yep. Sent SMS and email with links and deadline. Also asked for the utility bill to clear Checkr.
Paul G: Small compliance reminder: if the rep doing Section 2 is Redwood staff, include their full name, title, and office location on the rep form. If non-Redwood (notary), include notary details instead.
Nina C: Update 12:45: Mateo booked a notary for Mon 10am and uploaded the receipt. Checkr ticket created #CHK-8042.
HR Bot: Checkr ticket #CHK-8042 assigned to Rhea S.
Rhea S: Update 17:20: Checkr asked for a recent utility bill; Mateo uploaded it this afternoon. I submitted to vendor. Also confirmed he completed W-4 + direct deposit.
Tom W: Confirmed IT will ship laptop Mon AM with "Hold for ID". Ops will release after scan from notary arrives.
Paul G: Once Section 2 is uploaded, I'll mark the rep form complete and notify security to clear badge provisioning. Keep rep form in secure folder.
Nina C: Final: 19:05 Checkr cleared, notary-signed Section 2 uploaded by Mateo, payroll confirmed W-4/direct deposit, badge provisioning queued. Thanks team! :tada:
